model_limits: Structural core-only bracket; fit ribs and interference preload excluded.
Isotropic PETG and zero-clearance engaged supports are screening idealizations.
X restraints act at x0 and7.8 on r9.3..14.35mm annuli, using the minimum specified retention-washer OD28.7mm. Y/Z fixed on sleeve bores.
Actual nominal0.2mm washer gap, contact opening, friction and preload are not solved.

Beam quadratic displacement uses straight-sided swept geometry from the actual STEP endface. Consistent nodal traction integrates the clipped central100mm2 pressure patch exactly, even where the mesh crosses the patch boundary.
Six independent bracket cases use conservative direction bounds via triangle and Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities.
Physical acceptance remains BLOCKED without measured evidence.
raw_retention_policy: Complete raw FRD/DAT fields retained for finest bracket and beam. Coarse raw fields were genuinely solved and parsed, then omitted as regenerable output to keep the self-contained download manageable. All coarse input decks, meshes, successful solver logs, per-case summaries, mesh quality, reactions, envelope metrics and exact omitted-file hashes remain. --force regenerates all levels.
